A rectangular ingot of the equi-atomic Co20Cr20Fe20Mn20Ni20 (at%) HEA was cast via vacuum induction melting under an Ar atmosphere.
The rectangular ingot with dimensions of 100 × 35 × 7  mm3 was then solution-annealed at 1373 K for 6 h under Ar atmosphere, followed by water quenching to maintain the heat-treated microstructure.
It was subsequently cold-rolled at 298 K from a thickness of ~7.0 mm to ~1.2 mm (corresponding to an ~84% reduction in thickness).
